title: Pingpong protocol 1.0.0-draft
description: Generated from openapi.json by `npm run generate`. Reference a definition with `urn:pingpong:protocol:v1#/$defs/<name>`.

ProjectId.description: A project's id, also its namespace: `/projects/{project}`.

PublicKey.description: A project's public key. Clients send it when they connect, and applications with every API request.

ChannelName.description: A channel. `private-…` and `presence-…` channels need a signature from the application; any other channel is public.

EventName.description: The name of an event: printable ASCII, without spaces. Laravel's default event names (`App\\Events\\CommentCreated`) fit.

SocketId.description: The id of a Socket.IO socket, as the client reads it (`socket.id`). It stays the same when the socket is recovered.

Origin.description: An origin clients may connect from: a scheme, a host and an optional port, without a path. `*.` before the host allows its subdomains, one level or more, but not the host itself.

channels.description: The channels to send the message to. A socket subscribed to several of them receives it once per channel.

data.description: Any JSON value. The serialized message must fit in the project's limit (10 KB by default).

exceptSocketId.description: A socket that must not receive the message: the one whose action caused it (Laravel's `toOthers()`).

occupied.description: Whether at least one socket is subscribed.

subscriptionCount.description: The number of sockets subscribed right now.

origins.description: Clients that send an `Origin` header must send one of these. A client without one (a native app, a server) is accepted on the key alone.

RequestSignature.description: The `Pingpong-Signature` header of an API request: `t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`. The HMAC is of `{t}.{method}.{path}.{sha256}` with the project's secret, where `method` is upper case, `path` is the request target as sent (path and query string, without the host), and `sha256` is the hex SHA-256 of the body (of an empty body for a `GET`). Several `v1` values can follow: the request is valid if one of them matches the current secret or, during the grace period after a rotation, the previous one.

ChannelSignature.description: What the application gives a client to join a private channel: the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `{socketId}:{channel}` with the project's secret. In PHP: `hash_hmac('sha256', "$socketId:$channel", $secret)`.

SocketAuth.description: The `auth` of the Socket.IO handshake, on the namespace `/projects/{project}`.

SocketConnectError.description: The `message` of the `connect_error` a client receives when Pingpong refuses its connection. `unknown_project`, `invalid_key`, `origin_not_allowed` and `project_disabled` are final: the client stops reconnecting. `too_many_connections` is not: it retries.

SocketConnected.description: The `pingpong:connected` event, the first one a socket receives after each connection, recovered or not.

recovered.description: Whether the socket was recovered with its channels and what it missed. When it wasn't, the client subscribes again and reloads what it shows from the application.

SocketSubscribeRequest.description: The `subscribe` event, sent by the client with an acknowledgement.

SocketSubscribeError.description: `unsupported_channel`: presence channels are not supported yet. `too_many_channels`: the socket reached its limit of channels.

SocketUnsubscribeRequest.description: The `unsubscribe` event, sent by the client with an acknowledgement (`{ "ok": true }`).

SocketMessage.description: The `message` event: a message published to a channel the socket is subscribed to.

data.description: The JSON value that was published, if any.

SocketSubscriptionCount.description: The `pingpong:subscription_count` event: how many sockets are subscribed to a channel. Sent to its subscribers when the count changes, at most once every few seconds per channel.

type.description: URI of the problem type. `about:blank` when the status says it all.

errors.description: Validation errors: messages by JSON pointer to the invalid value in the request body (`/messages/3/channels/0`). The empty pointer is the body itself.
